defs.meaning: 贴标签于……；把……称为；（生化）示踪（label 的过去式和过去分词）

examples.zh: 她甚至把所有东西都贴上了标签。

examples.en: Why would anyone want to be labeled intolerant?
examples.zh: 为什么有人想被贴上不宽容的标签呢？

examples.en: It was on the opinion page, it was signed by one of the editors, and was clearly labeled as commentary.
examples.zh: 它在评论版上，由其中一位编辑签名，并清楚地标注为评论。
